modules.module_title: Inspect and mark each rough diamond

pcs.pc_description: examine each rough diamond using eye glass, 10x loupe, microscope, or digital rough- scanning tools (e.g., Sarine, Irys, DiaExpert) to understand inclusions, grain, tension, and shape.
identify inclusions such as cracks, feathers, cavities, naturals, graining, black spots, or twinning marks.

use traditional marking tools (pencil, ink, scriber) or laser/digital marking systems to make precise markings as per its classification, like windowing, cleavable, sawable, makeable, or for identification.
ensure that markings (manual or digital) do not damage the stone and are aligned with laser cutting or planning requirements.
check that markings comply with company standards, digital planning reports, and sustainability guidelines.
detect faulty markings, misalignment with internal inclusions, or tension lines using scopes or scanners, and correct them without damaging the stone.
ensure no weight loss or damaging scratches occur due to improper marking.
maintain zero loss of roughs, follow tracking protocols (RFID/barcode), and ensure stones are returned securely.
achieve productivity targets in terms of carats, number of pieces, or digital marking cycles, as per company KPIs.
deliver rough diamonds to the next process along with digital records, scans, and marking reports, within the required timeline.
ensure workflow continuity using digital dashboards, if available, and proper documentation.
inform supervisors immediately about delays or process disruptions
